item.title: 59-year-old man passes 2025 Bar Exams on 11th attempt
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – “Try lang. Hangga't buhay, may pag-asa.” This became the guiding mantra of Eduardo Regio, 59, who finally passed the 2025 Bar Examinations after his 11th attempt; an achievement that underscores perseverance and an unwavering commitment to a lifelong dream of becoming a lawyer.
